active_family: 309 learned center plus vanilla residual flow
current_bottleneck: The residual flow is now learning realistic short-horizon changes, jumps, and early uncertainty, but cumulative path anchoring is still wrong. The remaining failures concentrate in unconditional level distribution, late-horizon mean-reversion drift, regime width differentiation, and marginally weak cross-cell dependence.
last_result_summary: 309a versus 308a clarified the direction. Replacing the shell with a joint residual flow repaired h1 coverage, daily-change KS, move-size realism, jump q90/q99, cointegration ratio, and active mean-reversion cells, while lifting corr ratio from 0.032 to 0.492. The failures that remain are mostly long-horizon level/path balance, not missing stochasticity.
next_step_recommendation: Implement 310a: keep the learned deterministic center and the same vanilla joint flow core, but move the residual target from transition residuals to future-level/logit residual paths around the center. This is the cleanest way to target the level-KS and long-horizon drift failures without reintroducing shell engineering.
